outcome: Hospitalizations with a microcephaly ICD-9-CM discharge diagnosis code
cohort: The study included 8,860,153 hospital discharges of infants ≤1 year in California from 1999-2013.
finding: The overall incidence risk of microcephaly hospitalizations for infants ≤1 year was 7.70/10,000 live births and 6.78 per 10,000 hospitalizations, with significant heterogeneity observed in yearly rates.
